card.name: Label cell before a double-bar divider
card.fires_on: The last word or colon of a label in a flattened table row, just before the '||' cell divider. Typical labels are 'Estimated Primary Completion Date:' or 'Specialist Medical Reviewer'. It also fires on 'Optional' and on numbers in a '||' separated list.

modes.label: Field label before value
modes.description: Colon or last word of a label such as a date or reviewer field, right before the value cell.

modes.label: Table cell in a config list
modes.description: The cell 'Optional' in a scheme-element table, followed by '||' and a description.

modes.label: Number in a bar-separated list
modes.description: A number inside a long list of values joined by '||'.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of code-style '||' and '&&' operators, which fits a table divider coming next.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a label in a flattened table, just before the cell divider and the value.
